scope: eight unique frozen-final scientific scenes; each is rendered identically for three input modes

families.evidence: One cylinder intersects one flat liquid surface below its midpoint inside one open vessel.
Two panels preserve two carts and four wheels per state; only separation/contact changes.
One paper strip enters the solvent while all three spots remain above the solvent surface.
One membrane separates two compartments containing five round and three angular particles without direction marks.
Mouth, esophagus, stomach, intestinal path, and terminal tract form one uninterrupted tube.
Four paired chromosomes lie between two poles and each has fibers reaching both poles inside one cell.
One bowl-shaped crater depresses two continuous subsurface layers without texture or invented structures.
One flat-gray ice body occupies one U-shaped valley above exactly three basal clasts.
